items.title: Billy McBride and Mary McBride ("Mack and Mack") Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: She worked with lots of different shows, Emerson, Andy, and different ones.

ctx.x: Chattanooga, and Mandy that works on the television now. Mandy. Oh, yes. Who is she working with? Father Knows Best?
She worked with lots of different shows, Emerson, Andy, and different ones.
Well, Mandy, she was the mama. Well, now, she played piano in Annapolis. Oh, they had good piano players everywhere.
